summary: qsort-style comparator for two drivers addressed by the index bytes at this+0x0 into the 18624-byte-per-driver array base unk_5F070C. A driver whose status dword at +12 equals 3 (retired) sorts after an active driver; otherwise the integer rank dword at +11 is compared, then the float time/gap at +26 against the zero threshold flt_59E440, then the slot pointer addresses as a stable tiebreaker. Invoked by PitStopOrderRank (004D1BC0).

local_names.a1: driver index byte for the first driver
local_names.a2: driver index byte for the second driver
local_names.v2: slot base pointer for the first driver
local_names.v3: slot base pointer for the second driver
local_names.v4: status dword of the second driver (dword +12)
local_names.v5: rank dword of the second driver (dword +11)
local_names.v6: rank dword of the first driver (dword +11)
local_names.v12: rank dword of the second driver re-read (dword +11)
local_names.v13: rank dword of the first driver re-read (dword +11)
local_names.v7: equality flag set by the last rank comparison (a1 rank <= a2 rank)

operations.description: Slot base pointers: v2 = unk_5F070C + 18624 * a1_driver_index and v3 = unk_5F070C + 18624 * a2_driver_index, where each driver index is the byte read from field this+0x0 and the array stride is 18624 bytes per driver
Retired-first branch: when the status dword at v2 + 12 equals 3 (retired) and the status dword at v3 + 12 (v4) is not 3, return 1 so the retired driver sorts after the active one
Retired-vs-retired rank compare: when both status dwords equal 3, compare the rank dwords at +11 and return -1 when the first driver's rank (v6) is below the second driver's (v5)
Active-first branch: when the driver at v2 is not retired (status dword at +12 != 3) but the driver at v3 is retired (v4 == 3), return -1 so the active driver sorts first

Active-vs-active float compare at dword +26 (byte offset 104): return -1 when the float at v2 + 26 is not below the zero threshold flt_59E440, return 1 when it is strictly below zero, and otherwise compare the second driver's +26 float against the first's, returning -1 when greater and 1 when less
Rank tiebreak: v12 = the dword at v3 + 11 and v13 = the dword at v2 + 11; return -1 when the first driver's rank (v13) is below the second driver's (v12)

Common tail: if the equality flag v7 (a1 rank <= a2 rank, set by the last rank comparison) is false return 1; otherwise return -1 when the v3 pointer exceeds v2, else return the boolean v3 < v2 as the final stable tiebreaker
